title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Faskh Nikah 11838 views Q. Iddat Time 2885 views Q. I am from New Delhi.Married in August 2000.Two children,daughter 6 years old and son 3 years old now.Our married life was not happy.I work in Private Company and wife works in Govt.job. Due to differences between me and my wife,on 12th July,2008,left home,took a flat on rent, called her parents from U.P. and started living seperately.All efforts for reconcilation failed.She had even filed complaint against me in Police Station,and filed maintenance petition in 2009 against me in court,matter of which is pending. After all reconcilation efforts,including even by Court appointed mediators failed,I sent her letter of First Talaq on 26th april 2010 written in my hand writing and duly signed by two witnessess through Speed Post at her Residence address in Delhi and sent scannned copy of letter also by email to her.On phone she acknowledged receipt of both these.Then I sent second letter of Talaq again on 29th May 2010 in my own hand writing and signed by same two witnesseses again by speed post and scaned copy by email.I had also mentioned in that the reference of first talaq and that it was the second one.I got Delivery Report of Speed Post.Then on 3rd July 2010,I sent the Final and third Talaq Letter to her in same manner in my hand writing and signed by same two witnesses.I also emailed scanned copy by email to her.In that letter too I had mentioned reference of earlier two talaqs and said it is the third and final one.Again I got receipt of acknowldegement and delivery report from her end.In that third letter I had also mentioned that I want to pay her Mehar amount of Rs.one lakh only by cheque /draft and I want her to meet me at a neutral place of conbvenience so that I can hand it to over to her. Kindly note that the court case is for providing maintenance for children only.It has nothing to do with talaq.This court case she had filed in May/June 2009 much before I sent her Talaq letter in April 2010.she had filed that maintenanace case under Section 125 saying that she had been thrown out of house and as she is living seperately she needs maintenanace from my end. NOW IN LIGHT OF ABOVE FACTS: I want to know whether this talaq is proper and valid or not? Still her mehar amount is due to be paid.I am willing to pay her the amount.I had mentioned that clearly to her in my final and third talaq letter.The Bank Draft of Rs.One lakh is ready in her name.But I want to pay her in presence of witneses only. I want to know that in between the period when the mehar is yet to be paid, is talaq complete or not? 1983 views Q. assalmo alaikum my sister got married to my cousin. now she does not want to live with him. she insisted her husband that he give her talaq and she was excusing him of mehr. he said " tum aazad ho" at other moments he said "tum jisse shadi karn a chaho kar sakti ho". then he met again about 3 months later in the public place and said that he does not want to get seperated. to which my sister said that no she won't live with her and since then they are living apart. so is this khula valid? are they still in nikah?. 2971 views Q. May Allah bless you all! 2081 views Q. I have a daughter who is 11 months old.My wife passed away a couple of days after my daughter was born. 1654 views Q. A man was requesting to wife as he was outstation and had been shivering with high fever and malaria his query was to inform his wife over phone that he wants to come back to home due to illness but his wife could not listen attentively by heart and said that no need to come die there. On listening this sentence her husband couldn?t control himself and said Talaq Talaq..Talaq and many times even he told to give phone to your mother and repeated the same many times. But, just after that one of brides family member and guardian asked the groom that did really and intentionally said this words, he replies while weeping out and very brokenly that no his intention was not to give Talaq but punishment to her to change her attitude. Sir, please advise whether this is Talaq or not :- 1. As, he was over phone and from both the sides there was no evidences except her mother and at the place of husband there was no body in evidences. 2. That time her wife was in pregnancy period. 3. That, several times husband tried to meet her but wife never come to meet him. 4. That, they never allowed him to meet with baby girl at the time of birth and after onwards. 5. That, still husband tried a lot to convince them even from local people but worthless. But, now they want to unite in light of holy Quran and Hadith and peace be upon him. Refer to above question, please give us Fatwa accordingly, we would be highly obliged of you. 1800 views Q. I am asking this question for my sister. She got married 4 years back. 1582 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 11121 Country: United Kingdom Title: I have been seperated from my partner/ex since 2004 now. She walked out with son and made a court case alleging domestic violence etc. After 3 years, Halhamdulillah, the son lives me. She lost her as court decided that she has mental illness. Is Talaq automatic in this case? I have tried to patch up with her but she swore at the case workers.I have also given her talaq over the phone 2 years ago and also some other time, without witnesses but she says do whatever. She also said that my mother will goto hell when she passed away.I need to move on as I am ill and has a son to look after. Please give some advice. Jazakamuullah Khairun. Wa Sallam. Question: I have been seperated from my partner/ex since 2004 now. She walked out with son and made a court case alleging domestic violence etc. After 3 years, Halhamdulillah, the son lives me. She lost her as court decided that she has mental illness. Is Talaq automatic in this case? I have tried to patch up with her but she swore at the case workers.I have also given her talaq over the phone 2 years ago and also some other time, without witnesses but she says do whatever. She also said that my mother will goto hell when she passed away.I need to move on as I am ill and has a son to look after. Please give some advice. Jazakamuullah Khairun. Wa Sallam. Answer ID: 11121 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 456/375=D/1430) When you admit that you have given talaq on phone and some other time, then the talaq took place. If you have given three or more talaqs, then all the three talaqs took place and she became haram for you, you cannot rejoin without a valid halalah. Yes, it was not talaq till the time you had only quarrel without giving talaq. Now, if you like you can marry anywhere else or marry the same woman after valid halalah. Bring up the child in best of religious ways, keep on praying to Allah and fulfilling religious obligations. Note: If you did not give three talaqs (even if all put together), then please write the wording and number of talaq asking the question again, and enclose this fatwa too. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
